mountainbikes_bike_desc: A sturdy bike for hills and trails. You pedal it yourself, so it tires you out, but it needs no fuel and goes where a walker would crawl. Build it on dry land.
mountainbikes_help: W pedal, Shift+W sprint, S brake and back up, A and D steer, Jump or E to get off.
mountainbikes_too_far: Get closer to the mountain bike to climb on.
mountainbikes_too_heavy: You are carrying too much to ride.
mountainbikes_server_missing: Mountain Bikes isn't installed on this server, so mountain bikes can't be built here.
